== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Jek'nan, also known as the [[Flourishing Disease]], is a [[Fiend]] that has resided within a [[Pioneer world]] since the onset of the [[Abidan Collapse]]. He operates by spreading influence through various means, such as instigating rebellions, releasing viruses, or fostering tyrants. To maintain his secrecy from the [[The Hounds|Abidan Hounds]], he hides his activities as a series of improbable events. He utilizes an extensive underground network of roots that exists beneath reality to facilitate his thoughts and presence. His true form is a mass of twisted, multicolored ribbons shaped like a tree, which he can release when drifting through the Void. While Jek'nan has no direct history with the [[Abidan]], he possesses knowledge of them gathered from consuming world fragments and through mental connections with other [[Fiends]]. He is powerful enough to match several [[Wolves]], though he has encountered a [[black-armored Abidan]] that caused him significant fear and physical restraint.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This [[Fiend]] is characterized by the presence of branches. Known as the [[Flourishing Disease]], Jek'nan possesses a form that reflects this title.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Driven by the intent to digest fragments of an [[Iteration]], Jek'nan is a patient predator. The entity has spent centuries observing humans and has devoured thousands of them.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Jek'nan is capable of emitting screams at frequencies that are imperceptible to technology. In combat, this [[Fiend]] can match a squad of four average [[Wolves]] and possesses strength greater than a single [[Wolf]].}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Jek'nan is a [[Fiend]] known as the [[Flourishing Disease]], a creature possessing branches that has observed humans for centuries while devouring thousands of them. This entity intends to digest fragments of an [[Iteration]] by striking at the exact moment [[Way|the Way]] weakens. During its activities, Jek'nan emits screams in frequencies that technology is unable to perceive. Though it is stronger than a single [[Wolf]], the [[Fiend]] is an even match for a squad of four average [[Wolves]].}}
